description: Newest job postings ('projects') from Wantedly's public projects API, mostly Japanese employers: title, company name, location, what they look for (e.g. remote OK), publish time, page link. Pay and description are not returned. Text is in the language the employer wrote it, usually Japanese. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: jobs_wantedly
title: Jobs Wantedly
